target.definition: V85/V84 original physical structural cue at unchanged reference/uncertainty, before/after conditional AI observation. D is not wood-material membership; E is not foreign-depth single-ray proxy. These are not human native8 gold.
target.loss_operator: For each admitted FULL cue/view/tile, validity-normalized bilinear interpolation at nine fixed uncertainty-region locations; mean nine LOGITS then ONE BCE. Not nine material pixel labels. U/MISS/PARTIAL/unsupported terms zero gradient.
target.loss_admission: Original teacher loss_admitted AND actual region_available; never change q/L or choose a best tile. Nominal admitted terms remain in the sampler; report unavailable count and effective mass. No additional all-supported gate.
target.uncertainty_interpretation: Coarse region evidence; 9x9 cell spacing is L/9, so no precise corner localization claim.
target.synthetic_YCB_role: Only pretrained shared encoders from V88, itself based on synthetic V75 and YCB V87. New supervised labels are public Pallox physical cues only; do not merge clear-ray proxy or synthetic material pixels into D gold.
target.instance_association: No target instance or native-slot identity input. Physical cue association/initializer cue MISS remains separate and unproven.

sampling.within_class_probability: Normalize original teacher loss_weight; base cue/view mass1, each scale total.5 across all FULL tiles, seed duplicate members weight.5 in existing two groups.
sampling.unavailable: Keep nominal sampled terms; unavailable terms zero gradient. BCE mean over available sampled terms. Report loss of effective mass separately.
sampling.augmentation: No new online augmentation or query relocation.

validation.map_construction: Predict all129 fixed tiles of each of all56 VAL frames. Construct native480x640 map using fixed tent weights and validity-normalized bilinear logits. Complete every frame before the separate view-scoring reader is called. The full GT term loss-bank, including VAL coordinates, is loaded earlier, but only TRAIN terms enter training; no GT argument or label/region/FULL based tile selection enters mosaic construction.
validation.region: At completed native map sample same fixed nine uncertainty locations and mean LOGITS; r-only is a separate diagnostic.
validation.uncertainty_or_no_support: Factual no support/outside remains U, never forced D/E. Teacher U not treated as correct model U.

selection.criterion: Minimum equal mean of duplicate-weighted D and E known VAL region BCE; strict lower, earliest tie; only100..2000 eligible, update0 diagnostic.
selection.calibration: Fixed zero-logit threshold only; balanced-training scores are not calibrated deployment likelihood. No source/current threshold search.
